items.title: Fever overwhelmed by Aces, putting their season on the line
items.body_excerpt: The Fever huddle up on the court following the loss. LAS VEGAS — This was supposed to be Caitlin Clark’s spectacular return to the grandest stage, the playoffs. This was supposed to be proof that their final week of the regular season was an anomaly and they could turn the page…
